exposure: Liposomal bupivacaine infiltration in the transversus abdominis plane
cohort: 30 healthy pregnant women who underwent cesarean birth at term
finding: Bupivacaine is excreted in breast milk after local infiltration of liposomal bupivacaine and bupivacaine hydrochloride mixture into transversus abdominis plane blocks after cesarean birth, but relative neonatal dosages suggest minimal risks for breastfeeding healthy, term neonates.
